createlogisticscontrol.filter_link.not_p: Filter Link must be placed on a packager
createlogisticscontrol.config.filter_lin: Maximum distance (in blocks) a Filter Link may reach to select its filter target blocks.
createlogisticscontrol.ponder.filter_lin: Some recipes may not process correctly without a filter configured
A Filter Link can be used to automatically set filters to blocks
Right-click block with Filter Link to select as target
Any block with filtering capability is valid, and multiple targets can be selected
Afterwards, place the Filter Link on a Packager
Whenever the Packager unpacks a package with a filter label attached...
...the Filter Link automatically applies the filter to every configured target
Packages requested by Stock Keepers with JEI recipes, or by Factory Gauges, have their expected output attached as the filter label
